title: Concepts
text: timescales built around three concentric ideas. Working centre: Timeframes — atomic vocabulary (YEAR, MONTH, HOUR, …). Tokens — named recipes labels one timeframe (e.g. m12 = m01..m12, m12a = JAN..DEC). Calendars — actual partition year labelled leaves, formed composing tokens. users ever touch layer 3.

title: Concepts
text: timeframe unit time calendar can carry labels. package ships fixed core set: function as_timeframe() extracts value chosen timeframe datetime: format = "token" returns label style built-tokens use, calendar machinery needs internally.
code: CORE_TIMEFRAMES #>  [1] "YEAR"    "QUARTER" "MONTH"   "MDAY"    "YDAY"    "HOUR"    "MINUTE"  #>  [8] "SECOND"  "WDAY"    "MWEEK"   "WEEK" t <- as.POSIXct("2025-04-15 13:45", tz = "UTC") as_timeframe(t, "MONTH") #> [1] 4 as_timeframe(t, "MONTH", format = "token") #> [1] "m04" as_timeframe(t, "HOUR") #> [1] 13 as_timeframe(t, "WDAY", format = "token") #> [1] "TUE"

title: Concepts
text: token named, reusable recipe labels one timeframe, plus label’s within-year share. Tokens vocabularies shared across calendars. built-ins: Custom tokens added register_token().

title: Concepts
text: Calendar actual product one tokens. leaves resulting tree slices rest model talks . Three constructors, increasing flexibility: first two compose tokens Cartesian product; share product per-token shares scaled year_fraction. third escape hatch irregular calendars (e.g. representative weeks intentionally cover full year).
code: calendar("m12_h24")                    # layer 1: by name calendar_build("m12", "h24")           # layer 2: by token list calendar_from_leaves(leaves, ...)      # layer 3: by raw leaf table

what: What the leaves table looks like
title: Concepts
code: cal <- calendar("q4_h24") head(cal@leaves, 3) #>   QUARTER HOUR      share weight  slice #> 1      Q1  h00 0.01027397     90 Q1_h00 #> 2      Q2  h00 0.01038813     91 Q2_h00 #> 3      Q3  h00 0.01050228     92 Q3_h00 cat(nrow(cal@leaves), "leaves, share sums to", sum(cal@leaves$share)) #> 96 leaves, share sums to 1

title: Concepts
text: Conversion central verb. recast() function handles upsampling, downsampling, irregular--irregular mappings, given calendars cover year fraction.
code: cal_m <- calendar("m12")     # source: monthly cal_q <- calendar("q4")      # target: quarterly  monthly <- data.frame(   slice = cal_m@leaves$slice,   load  = c(120, 118, 105,  92,  85,  88,  95, 100,  98,  90, 105, 122) )  recast(monthly, from = cal_m, to = cal_q, year = 2025,        rule = "weighted_mean", by = "day") #>   slice      load #> 1    Q1 114.21111 #> 2    Q2  88.29670 #> 3    Q3  97.66304 #> 4    Q4 105.67391

title: Data structures
text: Tokens live internal environment, populated load time built-set extensible run time register_token(). token list two fields: timeframe — one CORE_TIMEFRAMES, expand — zero-argument function returning data.frame(label, share) share summing 1. Custom tokens behave identically built-ins:
code: list_tokens() #>  [1] "d360"  "d364"  "d365"  "d366"  "h168"  "h24"   "m12"   "m12a"  "min60" #> [10] "q4"    "w52"   "w53"   "wd7" m12 <- get_token("m12") m12$timeframe #> [1] "MONTH" head(m12$expand()) #>   label      share #> 1   m01 0.08493151 #> 2   m02 0.07671233 #> 3   m03 0.08493151 #> 4   m04 0.08219178 #> 5   m05 0.08493151 #> 6   m06 0.08219178 register_token("d4q", "YDAY", function() {   data.frame(label = c("Q1d", "Q2d", "Q3d", "Q4d"),              share = c(90, 91, 92, 92) / 365) }) calendar_build("d4q", "h24") #> <timescales::Calendar> #>  @ leaves    :'data.frame':  96 obs. of  5 variables: #>  .. $ YDAY  : chr  "Q1d" "Q2d" "Q3d" "Q4d" ... #>  .. $ HOUR  : chr  "h00" "h00" "h00" "h00" ... #>  .. $ share : num  0.0103 0.0104 0.0105 0.0105 0.0103 ... #>  .. $ weight: num  90 91 92 92 90 91 92 92 90 91 ... #>  .. $ slice : chr  "Q1d_h00" "Q2d_h00" "Q3d_h00" "Q4d_h00" ... #>  @ timeframes: chr [1:2] "YDAY" "HOUR" #>  @ levels    :List of 2 #>  .. $ YDAY: chr [1:4] "Q1d" "Q2d" "Q3d" "Q4d" #>  .. $ HOUR: chr [1:24] "h00" "h01" "h02" "h03" ... #>  @ meta      :List of 5 #>  .. $ name              : chr "d4q_h24" #>  .. $ desc              : chr "" #>  .. $ year_start        :List of 2 #>  ..  ..$ month: int 1 #>  ..  ..$ day  : int 1 #>  .. $ utc_offset_minutes: int 0 #>  .. $ year_fraction     : num 1

title: Data structures
text: validator Calendar enforces: required columns present @leaves, slice unique non-empty, share > 0 sum(share) == meta$year_fraction, weight >= 0, year_start carries valid month (1..12) day (1..31), utc_offset_minutes integer scalar, levels[[tf]] set-equal unique(leaves[[tf]]). violation throws construction time, Calendar hold always internally consistent.

title: Data structures
text: recast() returns data.frame column layout input — slice plus value columns — target calendar’s slice IDs. instant_to_slice() inverse direction (datetime → slice ID) returns character vector length input, NA instants outside calendar’s coverage.
code: src <- data.frame(slice = sprintf("m%02d", 1:12),                   load  = seq(100, 210, length.out = 12)) recast(src, from = calendar("m12"), to = calendar("q4"),        year = 2025, rule = "weighted_mean", by = "day") #>   slice     load #> 1    Q1 110.0000 #> 2    Q2 140.0000 #> 3    Q3 169.8913 #> 4    Q4 200.0000

title: Getting started with timescales
text: Energy-system, climate, operations models carve year discrete time slices. Different models pick different slicings: 365 days, 12 months, 4 quarters × 24 hours, 168 hours representative week, . slice labels arbitrary, shares year model-defined, converting data slicings error-prone. timescales represents slicing Calendar: ordered hierarchy timeframes (YEAR, MONTH, HOUR, …) whose terminal leaves form slices. one object get: stable schema slice labels year-share weights, well-defined mappings real datetimes, well-defined conversions two calendars covering year fraction.

title: Getting started with timescales
text: fastest path uses token-based names: Equivalent declarative form: full control lowest-level constructor calendar_from_leaves(), supply leaves table directly.
code: cal_my <- calendar("m12_h24")    # 12 months × 24 hours = 288 leaves cal_my #> <timescales::Calendar> #>  @ leaves    :'data.frame':  288 obs. of  5 variables: #>  .. $ MONTH : chr  "m01" "m02" "m03" "m04" ... #>  .. $ HOUR  : chr  "h00" "h00" "h00" "h00" ... #>  .. $ share : num  0.00354 0.0032 0.00354 0.00342 0.00354 ... #>  .. $ weight: num  31 28 31 30 31 30 31 31 30 31 ... #>  .. $ slice : chr  "m01_h00" "m02_h00" "m03_h00" "m04_h00" ... #>  @ timeframes: chr [1:2] "MONTH" "HOUR" #>  @ levels    :List of 2 #>  .. $ MONTH: chr [1:12] "m01" "m02" "m03" "m04" ... #>  .. $ HOUR : chr [1:24] "h00" "h01" "h02" "h03" ... #>  @ meta      :List of 5 #>  .. $ name              : chr "m12_h24" #>  .. $ desc              : chr "" #>  .. $ year_start        :List of 2 #>  ..  ..$ month: int 1 #>  ..  ..$ day  : int 1 #>  .. $ utc_offset_minutes: int 0 #>  .. $ year_fraction     : num 1 cal_my2 <- calendar_build("m12", "h24") identical(cal_my@timeframes, cal_my2@timeframes) #> [1] TRUE

title: Getting started with timescales
text: Calendar four parts: leaves plain data.frame. row one slice, columns: slice — unique slice ID, share — fraction year, weight — slice weight hours (default share * 8760), one column per timeframe — label level.
code: cal_my@timeframes               # the timeframe hierarchy, coarsest first #> [1] "MONTH" "HOUR" head(cal_my@leaves, 4)          # the leaf table (one row per slice) #>   MONTH HOUR       share weight   slice #> 1   m01  h00 0.003538813     31 m01_h00 #> 2   m02  h00 0.003196347     28 m02_h00 #> 3   m03  h00 0.003538813     31 m03_h00 #> 4   m04  h00 0.003424658     30 m04_h00 cal_my@levels$MONTH             # ordered label vocabulary per timeframe #>  [1] "m01" "m02" "m03" "m04" "m05" "m06" "m07" "m08" "m09" "m10" "m11" "m12" cal_my@meta[c("name", "year_fraction")] #> $name #> [1] "m12_h24" #>  #> $year_fraction #> [1] 1

title: Build a Calendar from a flat table of leaf slices — calendar_from_leaves
text: leaves data.frame one row per leaf slice. Must contain: one column per timeframe named timeframes share — numeric > 0; sums year_fraction weight — numeric >= 0; user-defined importance weight (optional) slice — unique character ID; auto-generated missing timeframes Ordered character vector timeframe names (coarsest first). must appear column leaves. levels Optional named list giving full ordered token set per timeframe. NULL, derived unique(leaves[[tf]]) first-appearance order. name, desc Calendar name free-text description. year_start list(month = , day = ); defaults January 1. utc_offset_minutes Integer minutes; model-local time = UTC + offset. year_fraction Fraction year covered sum(leaves$share). Defaults 1. ... Additional named entries appended meta (free-form).
